#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories
# Includes pre-deployment validation of environment variables
# Sends validated config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance

# Pre-deployment validation: Check .env.test for required variables
echo "=== Pre-deployment Validation ==="
if [ ! -f .env.test ]; then
    echo "Error: .env.test file not found!"
    exit 1
fi

# Read .env.test and check that each key has a value
declare -A env_vars
VALIDATION_PASSED=true
while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
        continue
    fi
    
    # Trim whitespace from key and value
    key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
    value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
    
    # Store in associative array
    env_vars["$key"]="$value"
    
    # Check if value is empty
    if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
        echo "Warning: Environment variable '$key' is empty in .env.test"
        VALIDATION_PASSED=false
    else
        echo "✓ '$key' is set"
    fi
done < .env.test

if [ "$VALIDATION_PASSED" = false ]; then
    echo "Validation failed: Some environment variables are empty"
    echo "Please fill in all required values in .env.test"
    exit 1
fi

echo "=== Pre-deployment Validation Passed ==="
echo ""

# Send validated config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance
echo "=== Sending Configuration to Deployment Orchestrator ==="
CONFIG_JSON="{"
first=true
for key in "${!env_vars[@]}"; do
    if [ "$first" = true ]; then
        first=false
    else
        CONFIG_JSON+=","
    fi
    # Escape quotes and backslashes in value for JSON
    escaped_value=$(echo "${env_vars[$key]}" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g' | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
    CONFIG_JSON+="\"$key\":\"$escaped_value\""
done
CONFIG_JSON+="}"

echo "POSTing configuration to http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"
HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "$CONFIG_JSON" \
    http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config)

if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" -ne 200 ]; then
    echo "Error: Failed to send configuration to orchestrator. HTTP Status: $HTTP_STATUS"
    exit 1
fi

echo "✓ Configuration successfully sent to deployment orchestrator"
echo ""

# Set variables for archive creation
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
RELEASE_NAME="release_${TIMESTAMP}"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${RELEASE_NAME}.tar.gz"

# Create the release archive
echo "Creating release archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
tar -czf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \
    --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='.env.*' \
    .

echo "Release archive created successfully: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "Contents of archive:"
tar -tzf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Get the current directory name for the archive
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$PWD")
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

echo "Creating release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"

tar --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='.git*' \
    -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" .

echo "Archive created successfully: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo "Size: $(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)"

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories as requested

# Set default archive name with timestamp
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz"

# Allow custom archive name as first argument
if [ "$#" -ge 1 ]; then
    ARCHIVE_NAME="$1"
fi

# Ensure the archive name ends with .tar.gz
if [[ ! "$ARCHIVE_NAME" =~ \.tar\.gz$ ]]; then
    ARCHIVE_NAME="${ARCHIVE_NAME}.tar.gz"
fi

echo "Creating release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo "Excluding: node_modules and .git directories"

# Create the tarball excluding node_modules and .git
# Using find to avoid issues with changing files during archive creation
find . -type f \
    ! -path "./node_modules/*" \
    ! -path "./.git/*" \
    -print0 | tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" --null -T -

# Check if the command was successful
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Successfully created archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
    echo "Archive size: $(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)"
else
    echo "Error creating archive!"
    exit 1
fi

            echo "❌ Error: Environment variable '$key' is not set"

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories
# Validates required environment variables
# Sends validated config to deployment orchestrator for audit

# Pre-deployment validation: Check .env.test for required variables
if [ -f ".env.test" ]; then
    echo "Validating environment variables from .env.test..."
    MISSING_VARS=0
    
    # Read each line in .env.test, ignoring comments and empty lines
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Check if the variable is set in current environment
        if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then
            echo "❌ Error: Environment variable '$key' is not set"
            MISSING_VARS=$((MISSING_VARS + 1))
        else
            echo "✓ Environment variable '$key' is set"
        fi
    done < .env.test
    
    if [ $MISSING_VARS -gt 0 ]; then
        echo "❌ Deployment aborted: $MISSING_VARS required environment variable(s) are not set"
        exit 1
    else
        echo "✓ All environment variables validated successfully"
        
        # Send validated config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance
        echo "Sending validated configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
        
        # Read .env.test and convert to JSON
        # Skip comments and empty lines, format as key-value pairs
        JSON_DATA="{"
        FIRST=true
        while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
            # Skip empty lines and comments
            if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
                continue
            fi
            
            # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
            key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
            value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
            
            # Skip if key is empty after trimming
            if [ -z "$key" ]; then
                continue
            fi
            
            # Add comma separator for JSON (except for first item)
            if [ "$FIRST" = true ]; then
                FIRST=false
            else
                JSON_DATA="$JSON_DATA,"
            fi
            
            # Escape quotes and backslashes in value for JSON
            escaped_value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g' | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
            
            # Add key-value pair to JSON
            JSON_DATA="$JSON_DATA\"\\"$key\\"\":\"$escaped_value\""
        done < .env.test
        JSON_DATA="$JSON_DATA}"
        
        # Send POST request to deployment orchestrator
        RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\nHTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}" -X POST "http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$JSON_DATA" 2>/dev/null)
        
        # Extract HTTP status and response body
        HTTP_STATUS=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | sed -n 's/.*HTTP_STATUS://p')
        RESPONSE_BODY=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | sed -e 's/HTTP_STATUS:[0-9][0-9][0-9]*$//')
        
        if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" -eq 200 ] || [ "$HTTP_STATUS" -eq 201 ] || [ "$HTTP_STATUS" -eq 202 ]; then
            echo "✓ Configuration sent to deployment orchestrator successfully"
        else
            echo "⚠️  Warning: Failed to send configuration to orchestrator (HTTP $HTTP_STATUS)"
            echo "   Response: $RESPONSE_BODY"
            # Continue deployment anyway as this is for audit, not blocking
        fi
    fi
else
    echo "⚠️  Warning: .env.test file not found, skipping environment validation and config upload"

        if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then
            echo "❌ Error: Environment variable '$key' is not set"
            MISSING_VARS=$((MISSING_VARS + 1))
        else
            echo "✓ Environment variable '$key' is set"

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories
# Includes pre-deployment validation of environment variables
# Sends validated config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance

# Set script to exit on error
set -e

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables
echo "=== Pre-deployment Validation ==="
if [ -f ".env.test" ]; then
    echo "Loading environment variables from .env.test"
    # Source the .env.test file to load variables
    # Using export to make them available to subprocesses
    set -a
    . .env.test
    set +a
    
    # Check each variable in .env.test has a value
    MISSING_VARS=0
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Check if variable is set and not empty
        if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Environment variable '$key' is not set or is empty"
            MISSING_VARS=$((MISSING_VARS + 1))
        else
            echo "✓ $key is set"
        fi
    done < .env.test
    
    if [ $MISSING_VARS -gt 0 ]; then
        echo "Validation failed: $MISSING_VARS required environment variables are missing"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "All environment variables validated successfully!"
    
    # Send validated config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance
    echo ""
    echo "=== Sending Configuration to Deployment Orchestrator ==="
    
    # Create JSON payload from .env.test file
    json_payload="{"
    first_line=true
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        
        # Skip if key is empty after trimming
        if [ -z "$key" ]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Add comma separator except for first item
        if [ "$first_line" = true ]; then
            first_line=false
        else
            json_payload="$json_payload,"
        fi
        
        # Escape quotes and backslashes in value for JSON
        escaped_value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g' | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
        
        # Add key-value pair to JSON
        json_payload="$json_payload\"$key\":\"$escaped_value\""
    done < .env.test
    
    json_payload="$json_payload}"
    
    echo "Sending configuration to http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"
    echo "Payload: $json_payload"
    
    # Send POST request to deployment orchestrator
    HTTP_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$json_payload" 2>/dev/null || echo -e "\n000")
    
    HTTP_BODY=$(echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE" | sed '$d')
    HTTP_STATUS=$(echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE" | tail -n1)
    
    # Check if curl failed completely (no response)
    if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" = "000" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: Failed to connect to deployment orchestrator at http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"

    fi
    
    if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" = "200" ] || [ "$HTTP_STATUS" = "201" ] || [ "$HTTP_STATUS" = "202" ]; then
        echo "✓ Configuration successfully sent to deployment orchestrator (HTTP $HTTP_STATUS)"
    else

        exit 1
    fi
    
else

fi

fi

# Deployment script to create a release archive with environment validation and config posting

# Set script to exit on any error

# Get current directory name for archive naming
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
CONFIG_ENDPOINT="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"

echo "Starting deployment process..."

# Pre-deployment validation: Check .env.test for required variables
if [ -f ".env.test" ]; then
    echo "Validating environment variables from .env.test..."
    
    # Read each line in .env.test, skip comments and empty lines
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Check if the variable is set in the current environment
        if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then
            echo "Error: Environment variable '$key' is not set."
            echo "Please set '$key' before deployment."
            exit 1
        fi
        
        # Optional: Check if the value is not empty (after removing quotes if present)
        value="${!key}"
        # Remove surrounding quotes if they exist
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/^["'\'']//' | sed 's/["'\'']$//')
        
        if [ -z "$value" ]; then
            echo "Error: Environment variable '$key' is set but empty."
            exit 1
        fi
    done < .env.test
    
    echo "All required environment variables are set and non-empty."
    
    # Send .env.test contents as JSON to deployment orchestrator
    echo "Sending deployment configuration to orchestrator..."
    
    # Read .env.test and convert to JSON format
    JSON_DATA="{"
    FIRST=true
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        
        # Add comma separator for JSON (except for first item)
        if [ "$FIRST" = true ]; then
            FIRST=false
        else
            JSON_DATA="$JSON_DATA,"
        fi
        
        # Escape quotes and backslashes in value for JSON
        escaped_value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g' | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
        
        # Add key-value pair to JSON
        JSON_DATA="$JSON_DATA\"$key\":\"$escaped_value\""
    done < .env.test

        # Continue deployment even if config posting fails

else

# Deployment script to create a release archive

# Validates required environment variables

set -e

    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do

        if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Check if value is empty
        if [[ -z "$value" || "$value" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
            echo "❌ Error: Environment variable '$key' is not set or is empty"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        echo "✅ $key is set"
    done < .env.test
    
    echo "All environment variables are properly set!"
    
    # Send validated config to deployment orchestrator
    echo ""
    echo "=== Sending Config to Deployment Orchestrator ==="
    echo "POSTing .env.test contents to http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"
    
    # Read .env.test and convert to JSON
    # Create temporary JSON file
    TEMP_JSON=$(mktemp)
    
    # Start JSON object
    echo '{' > "$TEMP_JSON"
    
    # Process each line in .env.test
    FIRST_LINE=true
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        
        # Add comma if not first line
        if [ "$FIRST_LINE" = true ]; then
            FIRST_LINE=false
        else
            echo ',' >> "$TEMP_JSON"
        fi
        
        # Escape quotes in value for JSON
        escaped_value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
        
        # Add key-value pair to JSON
        echo -n "\"$key\":\"$escaped_value\"" >> "$TEMP_JSON"
    done < .env.test

        echo "HTTP Status: $HTTP_STATUS"

        rm -f "$TEMP_JSON"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Clean up

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories
# Includes pre-deployment validation of environment variables

# Set script to exit on any error
set -e

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables in .env.test

    echo "Error: .env.test file not found!"
    exit 1

    # Skip empty lines and comments
    if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
        continue
    fi
    
    # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
    key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
    value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
    
    # Check if value is empty
    if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
        echo "Warning: Environment variable '$key' is empty in .env.test"

else
